ui:help.en: Ark API key (console: API key management), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 火山方舟的 API Key（控制台「API Key 管理」），以 Authorization: Bearer 发送；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。

ui:placeholder.zh: 留空使用默认地址 https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com

ui:help.en: Leave the default for Ark in China, or pick the BytePlus address; requests go to <Base URL><API path prefix>/chat/completions and the other paths below it. A trailing /api/v3 is removed, so the Ark SDK base URL can be pasted as it is. Any other address needs the account:settings:custom permission.
ui:help.zh: 使用方舟国内接口时保持默认，海外可选 BytePlus 地址；请求发往 <Base URL><API 路径前缀>/chat/completions 等路径。末尾的 /api/v3 会被去掉，所以可以直接粘贴方舟 SDK 的 base URL。填写其他地址需要 account:settings:custom 权限。

ui:placeholder.en: Leave empty - the layout follows the Base URL
ui:placeholder.zh: 留空即可 —— 路径布局由 Base URL 决定

ui:help.en: Normally leave this empty. An Ark address uses Ark's own layout (/api/v3/chat/completions). Ark itself does not serve Anthropic Messages at all, so that protocol needs a relay. Any other address is taken for an Ark-compatible relay and uses the standard paths (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages). Set this only for a relay that mirrors Ark's own paths under its own host - then everything, Anthropic included, is built under the prefix you give. It must start with / and can never move the request to another host.
ui:help.zh: 通常留空。填方舟地址就走方舟自己的布局（/api/v3/chat/completions）。方舟本身**不提供** Anthropic Messages，那个协议需要中转站；填其他地址则按 Ark 兼容中转站处理，走标准路径（/v1/chat/completions、/v1/messages）。只有当中转站在自己的域名下原样镜像方舟路径时才需要填 —— 填了之后所有路径（含 Anthropic）都建在这个前缀下。必须以 / 开头，任何情况下都不能把请求导到别的主机。

ui:title.zh: 视频 API 路径前缀

ui:help.en: Ark's native video task paths. A relay usually keeps these in a namespace of its own while serving text at the root - /doubao/api/v3 on the one this was verified against - because there is no standard place for them. Leave it empty for Ark itself. The task poll that settles the real cost uses this too, so a wrong value means every task is charged at its estimate.
ui:help.zh: 方舟原生视频任务的路径。中转站通常把它们放在自己的命名空间下、而文本在根上（本插件验证过的那个是 /doubao/api/v3），因为这些路径没有标准位置。用官方方舟就留空。按真实用量结算的任务轮询也用这个前缀，**填错等于每个任务都按预估收费**。

ui:placeholder.en: Leave empty to keep the asset library off

ui:help.en: Volcengine account access key id (console: Access Control). Only needed for the asset library, which is signed with the account's AK/SK instead of the API key. Leave this and the secret key empty and the account simply does not take part in the asset library.
ui:help.zh: 火山引擎账号的 Access Key ID（控制台「访问控制」）。只有素材库需要它：素材库用账号的 AK/SK 签名，不用 API Key。它和 Secret Key 都留空，这个账号就不参与素材库。

ui:placeholder.en: Required together with the access key
ui:placeholder.zh: 填了 Access Key 就必须填

ui:help.en: The secret half of the pair. Stored encrypted and never shown again. Filling in only one of the two is refused.
ui:help.zh: AK/SK 中的密钥部分。加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。两者只填一个会被拒绝。

ui:placeholder.zh: 留空使用默认地址 https://ark.cn-beijing.volcengineapi.com

ui:help.en: The Ark asset library OpenAPI endpoint. NOTE this is the Ark control plane and a DIFFERENT host from the Base URL above (which is the API host): asset calls are a signed POST / with ?Action=... Any other address needs the account:settings:custom permission.
ui:help.zh: 方舟素材库 OpenAPI 的地址。注意这是方舟的控制面，与上面的 Base URL（API 主机）不是同一个主机：素材库调用是带签名的 POST /，Action 放在查询参数里。填写其他地址需要 account:settings:custom 权限。

ui:help.en: Signing region of the asset library calls; it is part of the signature, so a wrong value is rejected upstream as a signature error rather than a region error. cn-beijing for Ark in China, ap-southeast-1 for the overseas (BytePlus) stack.
ui:help.zh: 素材库调用的签名区域；它是签名的一部分，填错了上游报的是签名错误而不是区域错误。方舟国内用 cn-beijing，海外（BytePlus）用 ap-southeast-1。
